newsitem.title: USA: US debt futures end up, off highs on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: US debt futures end up, off highs on profit-taking.

text.p: July 7 - U.S. debt futures closed higher, but off seven-mos highs due to profit-taking, traders said. Sept T-bonds slipped through support at 113-24/32. Near-term support now rests at 113-16/32. U.S. weekly retail sales reports and U.S. May consumer credit data will be released on Tuesday. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
